name: Knowledge Embeddings (Harrier)
description: Local, instruction-aware Harrier embeddings for memory search and Knowledge, through OpenClaw's managed llama.cpp server.

warmUp.description: Embed one query when the service starts, so the first search after a Gateway restart does not load the model. Default: on while Harrier is in use (memory.search.provider is harrier-local, or Knowledge vectors are on), otherwise off.

enabled.description: Keep a vectors index of every Knowledge store and partition (read-only), in this plugin's state directory. Default: on when Knowledge holds the memory slot and its owner search names this plugin (plugins.entries.knowledge.config.ownerSearch.vectors.plugin: "knowledge-embeddings"), otherwise off.

ownerSupplement.description: Offer the index to Knowledge's knowledge_owner_search as ids and scores only; Knowledge validates every hit. Answers only while Knowledge holds the memory slot. Default: on when Knowledge's owner search names this plugin, otherwise off.

intervalMs.description: Safety poll after the pass at service start (while watching, it also rescans the watched directories); 0 turns the poll off. Default 300000 while watching, 30000 when watch is off or unavailable.

watch.description: Reindex when Knowledge's record files change (non-recursive fs.watch on each record directory, read-only; Git and SQLite churn ignored). Falls back to polling if watching fails.

watchDebounceMs.description: Quiet time after the last change before a reindex. Default 2000.

batchSize.description: Documents per embed batch; small batches keep queries from waiting behind indexing. Default 2.
